scripts.icons: esbuild scripts/icon-board.tsx --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --jsx=automatic --outfile=node_modules/.tmp/icon-board.cjs && node node_modules/.tmp/icon-board.cjs && node scripts/render-icons.mjs
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-social-dart "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:run: npm run ios:sync && cap run ios
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:run: npm run android:sync && cap run android
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease assembleDebug
